title: About
text:
To learn more about this assignment, visit ABCamp’s Github.



The website must be live and functional (the site loads at the URL, navigation works, and nothing is broken)
There must be an index page (“YOU” are here)
There must be three pages minimum (including index). What the other two pages (my ‘About’ page and my ‘Resume’ page) include is up to you. All pages must be properly linked in the site navigation AND include SOME relevant content (i.e., no empty pages)
There must be at least one media item somewhere (picture, video, embedded pdf, etc.)
There must be at least one customization somewhere (theme/template, colors, TOC, etc.)
Everything should be neat, free of typos, and reflect thought and planning (e.g., no leftover template or placeholder text, page titles match the navigation, etc.)
